notes.title: Spirits of Carter Mansion now live on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41357165/25c1bf1f4f9ef6e043b4615cfab1b7e4eba70626.jpg[/img]
Spirits of Carter Mansion, a new spooky atmospheric puzzle game has you exploring a great haunted house while you try and unravel the story of the cursed estate, when really you're just trying to get your soccer ball back and escape!

-Carefully navigate the house with your eyes open and watch your bravery diminish, or close your eyes and be safe but lost.
-Unique tools to unlock, and puzzles to solve
-20 challenging achievements to unlock
-Huge expansive story that unravels as you discover more secrets of the great estate!



Are you brave enough to venture in, or will you become one of the Spirits of Carter Mansion?
